---
title: "GABM Logistic Regression"
author: "Ross"
date: "2025-04-25"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 0.  Packages (install broom.mixed if you haven’t already)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(data.table)    # fread
library(dplyr)         # data wrangling
library(fixest)        # feglm
library(lme4)          # glmer
library(broom)         # tidy.fixest
library(broom.mixed)   # tidy.glmerMod
library(purrr)         # map_df

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1.  Load & prep data
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df <- fread("Run1_Indiv_Data_for_logistic_regression.csv") %>%
  mutate(agent_key = paste0(`Run Number`, "_", name),
         id        = as.integer(factor(agent_key))) %>%
  rename(time                = `Time Step`,
         StayHome            = Response,
         SlightCough         = slight_cough,
         FeverCough          = cough_and_fever,
         CaseFeedback        = `Daily New Cases Day 4`,
         extraversion        = Extraversion,
         agreeableness       = Agreeableness,
         conscientiousness   = Conscientiousness,
         emotional_stability = `Emotional Stability`,
         intellect           = `Openness to Experience`) %>%
  mutate(CaseFeedback  = CaseFeedback * 1000,
         CaseFeedback2 = CaseFeedback^2)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2.  Fit the four models
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FE1 <- feglm(StayHome ~ SlightCough + FeverCough               | id,
             df, family = "logit")
FE2 <- feglm(StayHome ~ SlightCough + FeverCough + CaseFeedback | id,
             df, family = "logit")
FE3 <- feglm(StayHome ~ SlightCough + FeverCough +
                          CaseFeedback + CaseFeedback2          | id,
             df, family = "logit")
RE4 <- glmer(StayHome ~ SlightCough + FeverCough +
                          CaseFeedback + CaseFeedback2 +
                          agreeableness + conscientiousness + extraversion +
                          emotional_stability + intellect +
                          age + gender + (1 | id),
             df, family = binomial)

models <- list(FE1 = FE1, FE2 = FE2, FE3 = FE3, RE4 = RE4)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3.  Pull out coefficient tables (term, estimate, SE, z/t-stat, p-value)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
coef_table <- map_df(names(models), function(nm) {
  m <- models[[nm]]
  t <- if (inherits(m, "fixest")) {
    broom::tidy(m)
  } else {
    broom.mixed::tidy(m, effects = "fixed")
  }
  t %>%
    select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value) %>%
    mutate(model = nm)
}, .id = NULL)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4.  Pull out model-level stats: N, BIC, pseudo-R² (FE only)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
get_pR2 <- function(m) {
  if (inherits(m, "fixest")) {
    as.numeric(r2(m, type = "pr2"))  # McFadden R²
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
}

model_stats <- purrr::map_df(names(models), function(nm) {
  m <- models[[nm]]
  data.frame(
    model    = nm,
    N        = nobs(m),
    BIC      = BIC(m),
    PseudoR2 = get_pR2(m),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>%
  # Ensure one row per model in case of reruns
  distinct(model, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  # Format for readability
  mutate(
    N        = format(N, big.mark = ","),
    BIC      = sprintf("%.1f", BIC),
    PseudoR2 = ifelse(is.na(PseudoR2), "", sprintf("%.3f", PseudoR2))
  ) %>%
  select(model, N, BIC, PseudoR2)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5.  Inspect & save GOF table
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print(model_stats)

write.csv(model_stats, "final_model_gof_stats.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# (Optional: pretty display in RMarkdown)
if (requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  knitr::kable(
    model_stats,
    col.names = c("Model", "N", "BIC", "Pseudo R²"),
    caption  = "Goodness-of-Fit Statistics"
  )
}

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6.  (Optional) save coef table as well
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
write.csv(coef_table, "final_model_coefficients.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```
